en.title: oxycodone hydrochloride: Highlights, Drug Interactions has no instruction for a patient the label covers
en.summary: Highlights, Drug Interactions reads “Can potentiate the effects of morphine”. Example: The MAOI line in Highlights of an oxycodone label names morphine; section 7 does not. The same text is in 63 labels from 28 labelers in the DailyMed release of 29 October 2026.
en.impact: Potential effect on a prescribing decision: low; careful reading of the whole label usually resolves it. Arxo does not say which instruction is correct and gives no dose.

ai_role.en: AI agents read the labels, compared their parts and, where marked, ran the example patient through executable rules; an AI agent then read each place in full, with tables and footnotes, and confirmed it. No clinician has assessed these places. A person at Arxo approved publication (2026-10-31).
